OCR_NUMERIC_DISAGREEMENT.message: Multiple observations for the same logical numeric cell disagree materially.
OCR_NUMERIC_DISAGREEMENT.detection: Aligned observations parse as different exact numeric values.

TEXT_OBSERVATION_CONFLICT.message: Text observations for one logical token conflict without a trusted resolution rule.
TEXT_OBSERVATION_CONFLICT.detection: Aligned normalized text differs and no qualified native/OCR rule resolves it.

TEXT_CONFUSABLE_DISAGREEMENT.message: OCR differs only by qualified confusable characters from strong native text.
TEXT_CONFUSABLE_DISAGREEMENT.detection: Strong native text and OCR normalize to a configured confusable-equivalent token.

PDF_TEXT_MAPPING_CORRUPT.message: Native PDF text mapping is explicitly qualified as corrupt; unanimous OCR is selected.
PDF_TEXT_MAPPING_CORRUPT.detection: NativeTextQuality is mapping_corrupt and aligned OCR observations agree.

TABLE_CELL_PASS_MISSING.message: A required extraction pass has no observation for an aligned logical cell.
TABLE_CELL_PASS_MISSING.detection: Exact row/column alignment finds a missing required pass cell.

TABLE_PAGE_SURFACE_REQUIRED.message: Governed table extraction requires an explicit page-bearing source surface.
TABLE_PAGE_SURFACE_REQUIRED.detection: Table pass input lacks pageNumber on its bound source surface.

PROVIDER_PIXEL_CONVENTION_UNKNOWN.message: Provider geometry coordinate convention is unknown.
PROVIDER_PIXEL_CONVENTION_UNKNOWN.detection: Provider profile reports unknown or undeclared pixel convention for geometry-bearing output.

OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_SURFACE_REQUIRED.message: Provider geometry is present without an explicit provider surface.
OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_SURFACE_REQUIRED.detection: Observation contains providerGeometry but no provider surface identity.

OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_PROFILE_CONFLICT.message: Observation provider identity conflicts with its supplied provider profile.
OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_PROFILE_CONFLICT.detection: Observation role/provider/version or explicit profile hash differs from ProviderProfile.v1.

NATIVE_QUALITY_PROFILE_CONFLICT.message: Native text quality assessment is not bound to the observation provider profile.
NATIVE_QUALITY_PROFILE_CONFLICT.detection: NativeTextQuality assessmentProfileHash differs from observation providerProfileHash.

NATIVE_QUALITY_HASH_INVALID.message: Native text quality content does not match its claimed hash.
NATIVE_QUALITY_HASH_INVALID.detection: Recomputed canonical NativeTextQuality hash differs from nativeQualityHash.

DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.message: DOCX rendered-page evidence lacks required renderer, environment, font, or display-policy identity.
DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.detection: RenderProfile.v1 for documentKind=docx omits a required reproducibility field.

DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_CHANGED.message: DOCX semantic source is unchanged but rendered-page profile identity changed.
DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_CHANGED.detection: Source semantic hash matches while renderProfileHash differs.

TRANSFORM_NONINVERTIBLE.message: Surface transform is singular and cannot be inverted.
TRANSFORM_NONINVERTIBLE.detection: Affine determinant is zero or below the numerical singularity gate.

TRANSFORM_ROUNDTRIP_FAILED.message: Surface transform exceeds the declared continuous round-trip tolerance.
TRANSFORM_ROUNDTRIP_FAILED.detection: Deterministic fiducial forward/inverse error exceeds the contract gate.

OVERLAY_STALE_SOURCE.message: Overlay source hash does not match the current document source.
OVERLAY_STALE_SOURCE.detection: Overlay sourceHash differs from active source identity.

OVERLAY_STALE_TRANSFORM.message: Overlay transform hash does not match the current surface transform.
OVERLAY_STALE_TRANSFORM.detection: Overlay surfaceTransformHash differs from the active transform identity.

EVIDENCE_HASH_INVALID.message: Canonical evidence content does not match its claimed hash.
EVIDENCE_HASH_INVALID.detection: Recomputed canonical hash differs from the stored evidence hash.
